native_bridge_build.warning_note: Known Autodesk-reference MSB3277 warning families remain unsuppressed baseline debt.

debug_findings.finding: Initial LWPOLYLINE update removed every vertex before re-adding the requested set.
debug_findings.measured_native_error: Autodesk.AutoCAD.Runtime.Exception / DegenerateGeometry when RemoveVertexAt(0) was called with one remaining vertex.
debug_findings.resolution: Update now rebuilds in place: open the polyline, SetPointAt over the shared prefix, remove only excess tail vertices or add missing tail vertices, then apply Closed last.
debug_findings.verification: Live AutoCAD acceptance passes 4->2 shrink and 2->5 grow with COM parity and persistent PID/Handle identity.

debug_findings.finding: O1 N6 simple-polyline validator referenced Mapping without importing it.
debug_findings.resolution: Import Mapping from collections.abc; post-commit validator no longer crashes.
debug_findings.verification: Focused regression and live nine-step N6 state-chain acceptance pass.

limitations: O1 remains an internal staged native surface; public MCP stays at the existing 50-tool release-candidate contract.

LWPOLYLINE create/update intentionally covers simple 2D zero-elevation +Z geometry with zero bulge and zero per-vertex widths; complex existing polylines are refused for update as UNSUPPORTED_TARGET_GEOMETRY.
Native semantic extraction remains bounded by MaxSnapshotEntities=32 and the current frame-size limit.
Native relation/topology extraction remains empty; O1 does not claim topology validation.
Post-commit R1/R2 recovery and process-restart journal resume remain outside O1 and N7 remains NOT STARTED.
decision: O1 CLOSED / LIVE PASS for typed CIRCLE, ARC and simple LWPOLYLINE create/update/delete over the existing parent-fingerprint, PID, transaction/R0 and N6 semantic state-chain foundation. N7 remains NOT STARTED and the staged bridge is not publicly promoted.
